title: doge-repo
description: A long-running QQ bot codebase evolving from CQP to Mirai and AstrBot, preserving multiple generations of plugin architecture and bot operations.

title: Tangut-Chinese Translator
description: A Tangut-Chinese translation prototype that combines dictionary scraping, sparse-script processing, and LLM-assisted interpretation for a low-resource historical writing system.

title: AI Emoji Kitchen Lab
description: A deep-learning experiment for Google Emoji Kitchen-style emoji fusion, exploring image generation, spatial priors, and small-sample visual synthesis.

title: PDF Summary Tool
description: A Python pipeline for converting PDFs into structured text and generating AI-assisted summaries, keywords, and reusable reading notes.

title: TeX-QB-Gen
description: A question-bank generator that extracts math problems from images, web pages, and PDFs through multimodal models, local OCR, and uniform TeX output.

title: bibliotheca-runnel
description: The personal academic portal and archive behind this site, integrating mathematical notes, projects, fragments, classical writing, and research records.

title: CER System
description: A banking customer-emotion recognition system based on Qwen2-Audio 7B, using a dual-path audio pipeline to adapt to different call-recording qualities and service scenarios.

title: tangut-nlp
description: This is an ultra-low-resource research codebase that translates short Tangut titles into modern Chinese using only 491 parallel pairs, achieving its strongest results via a hybrid workflow of frontier prompt‑only models and locally trained DPO‑repaired candidates rather than any single approach.

title: lean-portfolio-attribution
description: Lean Portfolio Attribution is a research codebase that attributes inference-time gains in Lean theorem proving via fixed-budget attempt portfolios, retrieval-free controls, matched-compute baselines, and cross-system portability checks against external provers like ReProver.

title: coral-travel-planner
description: CORAL is a research codebase that enhances trustworthy travel planning by directly parsing natural-language queries and applying localized repair, boosting pass rates on TravelPlanner and ChinaTravel while addressing benchmark infeasibility and constraint consistency.

title: proof-countermodel-distill
description: This project studies whether logical-reasoning LLMs should be trained to emit three different evidence regimes: PROVE for entailed queries, REFUTE for contradicted queries, ABSTAIN for unsupported queries with a missing-support witness.

title: INM-TeX
description: An English TeX reconstruction of Informal Notes on Mathematics, with corrected and expanded notes compiled into a book-length PDF.

title: rzk-ai4math
description: This repository studies LLM autoformalization on Rzk/sHoTT body-completion tasks, with an emphasis on shape-heavy held-out definitions, lightweight structural priors, repair, routing, and Lean portability checks.
